recipe_freeze: Before any follow-up outcome predictions; original-study outcomes have been examined. No smoke-score-based recipe changes.

stable_scaling.mean: inverse-assay-SE weighted training mean per column
stable_scaling.variance: weighted population variance per column about its own weighted mean
stable_scaling.global_spread: sqrt(mean(per-column weighted population variances)), over all 768 dimensions including constants
stable_scaling.zero_spread: all scales equal epsilon; centered training rows zero; unseen shifts remain unclipped

target_centering: inverse-assay-SE weighted mean of inner-training labels or final-fit labels; no target variance scaling
neural_architecture: 768-128-ReLU-1, same original RepresentationMLP and random initializations
neural_optimizer: AdamW; original minibatch-normalized weighted smooth-L1 beta=.5 and gradient norm clipping at 1; no prediction clipping
model_selection: pooled inner-OOF inverse-assay-SE weighted MAE, first declared seed; grid-order then earliest-epoch ties; GroupKFold on supplied groups; at least two distinct groups required
replay: trusted-local pickle state; same batch size 1024 exact seed replay; changed batch shapes tolerance explicitly separate
evaluation: same original test rows; calibration suffix only for split-conformal intervals; no calibration/test labels to factory
supervision: systemd user nesso-pxr-followup-readouts; no wall-clock limit; exclusive lock; source/input/runtime-bound resume; failed tasks retained and full reconciliation required
